title: Bootstrap of the edges of a transition network
description: 200 bootstrap resamples of the sequences, seed 1 on both sides. Both programs draw the same resamples from the same random stream, so the bootstrap mean, standard deviation, stability p-value, significance, percentile interval and consistency range of every edge are compared directly, not as Monte Carlo estimates.
